name: AGC-004 — QR-Code Phishing Indicator
description: Execution & Documentation Note: This scenario was executed and documented in full by Claude (Anthropic AI), operating autonomously on the lab infrastructure. All commands, detection analysis, investigation steps, and conclusions in this report were performed by AI, not by a human analyst. | AGC-004: Phishing email delivers malicious URL via embedded QR code image, bypassing email gateway URL scanning. Verdict: True Positive, Confidence: Medium.

techniques.comment: AGC-004: QR-code phishing. Email contains QR code image encoding http://10.10.40.10/portal-login - no extractable text URL. Bypasses email gateway URL scanning entirely. Simulated post-scan GET returned HTTP 200 credential harvester. Detection gap: no QR-decode capability at email layer. Correlation is timing-based only. Verdict: True Positive, Confidence: Medium.
